changed: The test ring in Reminders & alerts now fires after a minute, so you can leave the app first and hear it the way a real alarm rings
Changing a reminder's time to one that has already passed today moves it to the next day, instead of leaving it on a date that has gone
fixed: Alarm-style reminders ring again when the phone is unlocked or in vibrate mode, instead of arriving as a silent notification
A reminder can no longer be saved with a time in the past, where it would never ring
